audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim wilderness-memory, manna, good-land, and wealth-warning discourse, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for wilderness humbling/testing, manna, not-by-bread-alone, parental discipline imagery, good-land catalogue, satisfaction and blessing, wealth/forgetting warning, and power-to-gain-wealth theology.

verses.restored: All command I command you today you shall keep to do, so you may live and multiply and enter and possess land YHWH swore to your fathers.

familiar.text: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.

modern.text: You must carefully follow every commandment I am giving you today, so that you may live and multiply, and enter and possess the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers.

original.text: כָּל הַמִּצְוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם תִּשְׁמְר֣וּן לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽחְי֜וּן וּרְבִיתֶ֗ם וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall remember all way YHWH your Divine led you these forty years in wilderness, to humble you, test you, and know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commands or not.

familiar.text: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.

modern.text: Remember that these forty years the LORD your God led you all the way in the wilderness, so that He might humble you and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep His commandments.

original.text: וְזָכַרְתָּ֣ אֶת כָּל הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֹלִֽיכֲךָ֜ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ זֶ֛ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְמַ֨עַן עַנֹּֽתְךָ֜ לְנַסֹּֽתְךָ֗ לָדַ֜עַת אֶת אֲשֶׁ֧ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֛ הֲתִשְׁמֹ֥ר מצותו אִם לֹֽא

verses.restored: He humbled you and made you hunger and fed you manna, which you did not know and your fathers did not know, to make you know that not by bread alone does humanity live, but by everything going out from mouth of YHWH does humanity live.

familiar.text: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

modern.text: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.

original.text: וַֽיְעַנְּךָ֮ וַיַּרְעִבֶךָ֒ וַיַּֽאֲכִֽלְךָ֤ אֶת הַמָּן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא יָדַ֔עְתָּ וְלֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן הוֹדִֽעֲךָ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א עַל הַלֶּ֤חֶם לְבַדּוֹ֙ יִחְיֶ֣ה הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֛י עַל כָּל מוֹצָ֥א פִֽי יְהוָ֖ה יִחְיֶ֥ה הָאָדָֽם

verses.restored: Your garment did not wear out upon you, and your foot did not swell these forty years.

familiar.text: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

modern.text: Your clothing did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.

original.text: שִׂמְלָ֨תְךָ֜ לֹ֤א בָֽלְתָה֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְרַגְלְךָ֖ לֹ֣א בָצֵ֑קָה זֶ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה

verses.restored: Know with your heart that as a man disciplines/instructs his son, YHWH your Divine disciplines/instructs you.

familiar.text: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.

modern.text: So know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.

original.text: וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ עִם לְבָבֶ֑ךָ כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְיַסֵּ֥ר אִישׁ֙ אֶת בְּנ֔וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מְיַסְּרֶֽךָּ

verses.restored: You shall keep commands of YHWH your Divine, to walk in his ways and fear/revere him.

familiar.text: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

modern.text: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, walking in His ways and fearing Him.

original.text: וְשָׁ֣מַרְתָּ֔ אֶת מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לָלֶ֥כֶת בִּדְרָכָ֖יו וּלְיִרְאָ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: For YHWH your Divine is bringing you into good land, land of streams of water, springs and deep waters going out in valley and mountain,

familiar.text: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;

modern.text: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks and fountains and springs that flow through the valleys and hills;

original.text: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מְבִֽיאֲךָ֖ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ טוֹבָ֑ה אֶ֚רֶץ נַ֣חֲלֵי מָ֔יִם עֲיָנֹת֙ וּתְהֹמֹ֔ת יֹצְאִ֥ים בַּבִּקְעָ֖ה וּבָהָֽר

verses.restored: land of wheat and barley, vine and fig and pomegranate, land of olive oil and honey/date syrup,

familiar.text: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;

modern.text: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey;

original.text: אֶ֤רֶץ חִטָּה֙ וּשְׂעֹרָ֔ה וְגֶ֥פֶן וּתְאֵנָ֖ה וְרִמּ֑וֹן אֶֽרֶץ זֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶן וּדְבָֽשׁ

verses.restored: land where you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall lack nothing in it, land whose stones are iron and from whose mountains you may quarry copper.

familiar.text: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

modern.text: a land where you will eat food without scarcity, where you will lack nothing; a land whose rocks are iron and whose hills are ready to be mined for copper.

original.text: אֶ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹ֤א בְמִסְכֵּנֻת֙ תֹּֽאכַל בָּ֣הּ לֶ֔חֶם לֹֽא תֶחְסַ֥ר כֹּ֖ל בָּ֑הּ אֶ֚רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲבָנֶ֣יהָ בַרְזֶ֔ל וּמֵהֲרָרֶ֖יהָ תַּחְצֹ֥ב נְחֹֽשֶׁת

verses.restored: You shall eat and be satisfied, and bless YHWH your Divine for good land he gave you.

familiar.text: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

modern.text: When you eat and are satisfied, you are to bless the LORD your God for the good land that He has given you.

original.text: וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבֵֽרַכְתָּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ עַל הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן לָֽךְ

verses.restored: Guard yourself lest you forget YHWH your Divine by not keeping his commands and judgments and statutes that I command you today,

familiar.text: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

modern.text: Be careful not to forget the LORD your God by failing to keep His commandments and ordinances and statutes, which I am giving you this day.

original.text: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לְבִלְתִּ֨י שְׁמֹ֤ר מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם

verses.restored: lest you eat and are satisfied and build good houses and dwell in them,

familiar.text: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;

modern.text: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses in which to dwell,

original.text: פֶּן תֹּאכַ֖ל וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבָתִּ֥ים טוֹבִ֛ים תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְיָשָֽׁבְתָּ

verses.restored: and your cattle and flocks multiply, silver and gold multiply for you, and all you have multiplies,

familiar.text: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;

modern.text: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all that you have is multiplied,

original.text: וּבְקָֽרְךָ֤ וְצֹֽאנְךָ֙ יִרְבְּיֻ֔ן וְכֶ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב יִרְבֶּה לָּ֑ךְ וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר לְךָ֖ יִרְבֶּֽה

verses.restored: and your heart is lifted up and you forget YHWH your Divine who brought you out from land of Egypt, from house of slaves,

familiar.text: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;

modern.text: then your heart will become proud, and you will forget the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

original.text: וְרָ֖ם לְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְשָֽׁכַחְתָּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַמּוֹצִיאֲךָ֛ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים

verses.restored: who led you through great and fearful wilderness, with fiery serpent and scorpion and thirsty ground where there was no water, who brought water for you from flint rock,

familiar.text: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

modern.text: He led you through the vast and terrifying wilderness with its venomous snakes and scorpions, a thirsty and waterless land. He brought you water from the rock of flint.

original.text: הַמּוֹלִ֨יכֲךָ֜ בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר הַגָּדֹ֣ל וְהַנּוֹרָ֗א נָחָ֤שׁ שָׂרָף֙ וְעַקְרָ֔ב וְצִמָּא֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵֽין מָ֑יִם הַמּוֹצִ֤יא לְךָ֙ מַ֔יִם מִצּ֖וּר הַֽחַלָּמִֽישׁ

verses.restored: who fed you manna in wilderness that your fathers did not know, to humble you and test you, to do good to you in your latter end,

familiar.text: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;

modern.text: He fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers had not known, in order to humble you and test you, so that in the end He might cause you to prosper.

original.text: הַמַּֽאֲכִ֨לְךָ֥ מָן֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן עַנֹּֽתְךָ֗ וּלְמַ֨עַן֙ נַסֹּתֶ֔ךָ לְהֵיטִֽבְךָ֖ בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: and you say in your heart, My power and might of my hand made me this wealth.

familiar.text: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.

modern.text: You might say in your heart, “The power and strength of my hands have made this wealth for me.”

original.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ כֹּחִי֙ וְעֹ֣צֶם יָדִ֔י עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖י אֶת הַחַ֥יִל הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: You shall remember YHWH your Divine, for he is the one giving you power to make/gain wealth, in order to establish his covenant he swore to your fathers, as this day.

familiar.text: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.

modern.text: But remember that it is the LORD your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day.

original.text: וְזָֽכַרְתָּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כִּ֣י ה֗וּא הַנֹּתֵ֥ן לְךָ֛ כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת חָ֑יִל לְמַ֨עַן הָקִ֧ים אֶת בְּרִית֛וֹ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: It shall be, if you surely forget YHWH your Divine and go after other gods and serve them and bow to them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.

familiar.text: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.

modern.text: If you ever forget the LORD your God and go after other gods to worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely perish.

original.text: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם שָׁכֹ֤חַ תִּשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהָֽלַכְתָּ֗ אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַעֲבַדְתָּ֖ם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם הַעִדֹ֤תִי בָכֶם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י אָבֹ֖ד תֹּאבֵדֽוּן

verses.restored: Like nations YHWH causes to perish from before you, so you shall perish, because you did not listen to voice of YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.

modern.text: Like the nations that the LORD has destroyed before you, so you will perish if you do not obey the LORD your God.

original.text: כַּגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְהוָה֙ מַאֲבִ֣יד מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם כֵּ֖ן תֹאבֵד֑וּן עֵ֚קֶב לֹ֣א תִשְׁמְע֔וּן בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם

translation_notes: The wilderness is interpreted as humbling and testing, but this must not be generalized into a claim that every deprivation, abuse, or disaster is divinely imposed for character development.
'Not by bread alone' does not minimize material hunger; the same verse first says YHWH fed the people manna.
Parental-discipline imagery must never justify physical abuse or coercive religious discipline.
The good-land catalogue celebrates water, biodiversity, staple crops, fruit, minerals, satisfaction, and gratitude.
The central economic warning is against self-made mythology: wealth can lift the heart into forgetting slavery, dependence, community, and Divine gift.
Power to gain wealth is covenant responsibility, not prosperity-gospel proof of personal virtue.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 8 to romanticize hunger, excuse abuse, shame poverty, preach prosperity theology, or claim wealth proves Divine favor. Its enduring warning is that abundance becomes dangerous when people forget liberation, dependence, gratitude, and the labor supporting their comfort.
